title: Setting the Table
text: Hi! My name is Amy. Every night, I help my mother set the table. I put a plate and a bowl for each person. Next to the plate, I put a fork and a knife. My grandma likes to use chopsticks instead of a fork. Everyone gets a cup for water or tea. Dinner is ready!

questions.question: What does Amy put next to the plate?
questions.source_sentence: Next to the plate, I put a fork and a knife.
